automation_evidence.quote: we introduce Dr-CiK, a benchmark for evaluating whether agents can retrieve forecasting-relevant supporting context from a document corpus, filter out distractors

evidence.quote: With supporting evidence, DP-Gemini and MoiraiAgent substantially outperform their no-context counterparts, showing that they are capable of leveraging contextual information.

practical_problems.note: Compares no context, ground-truth supporting evidence and DR-retrieved evidence, plus a hops ablation; DR evidence from some agents is worse than no context.

evidence.quote: Level 2: Deep Research. Isolates the DR agent's retrieval and synthesis quality (Evidence Recall, Document Recall, Distractor Avoidance), independent of the forecaster.

practical_problems.note: Measures whether agents recover ground-truth supporting evidence and avoid distractors; most recover under 5% of evidence.

evidence.quote: Two sources receive date adjustment as a contamination mitigation: Melbourne pedestrian counts are shifted forward by seven years and Eurostat rail by nine years

practical_problems.note: Date shifts and leakage audits protect benchmark validity, but no experiment varies or measures leakage.

summary: Dr-CiK is a testbed of 240 tasks where agents must retrieve forecast-relevant context from a corpus with distractors; it shows ground-truth context helps, while current deep research agents recover little evidence and can hurt forecasts.
